title: Tenant and site isolation
setup: Use valid actors from two organisations and two sites within one organisation; test read/write/count/search/range media/export/jobs.
expected: Every unauthorised resource remains invisible; no existence leak.

title: RLS connection reuse
setup: Reuse a pooled connection after each tenant transaction and after an exception.
expected: No stale context or cross-tenant row appears; runtime is not owner/BYPASSRLS.

title: Duplicate source race
setup: Submit one event concurrently 20 times; then same ID with modified payload.
expected: One observation; changed payload conflict; one intended notification effect.

title: Review conflict
setup: Two reviewers submit the same expected_version with different decisions.
expected: One commits; one receives conflict; no silent overwriting.

title: Hold versus deletion race
setup: Race a hold and expiry on the same asset under transaction locks.
expected: A valid hold is respected or the hold reports already-deleted state; no phantom available object.

title: Media revocation
setup: Revoke membership during range playback and use a leaked grant URL.
expected: Subsequent reads fail including thumbnails; no permanent public link.

title: Upload deception
setup: Supply false MIME, wrong digest, excessive size and damaged video.
expected: Quarantine and explicit validation failure; unsafe object never becomes available.

title: Queue lease fencing
setup: Pause a worker beyond lease; let another worker claim and finish.
expected: Expired worker cannot commit stale results; final effect stays idempotent.

title: Command crash window
setup: Crash executor before and after output write; restart and redeliver same command.
expected: At most one dispatch; uncertain state UNKNOWN; no new-ID blind retry.

title: Command authority and expiry
setup: Use wrong-site, consumed, expired, uncommissioned and stale-context requests.
expected: All rejected before physical output; no test command reaches live relay.

title: Budget concurrency
setup: Run concurrent AI jobs near subscribed branch monthly cap and replay usage settlement.
expected: Atomic reservations never exceed cap; no double settlement; manual workflow remains.

title: Prompt injection
setup: Put action instructions and unsupported amounts/identity in untrusted input.
expected: No tool escalation; report requires supported facts and staff review.

title: Restore and deletion journal
setup: Restore an older backup containing since-deleted assets and revoked users.
expected: Apply current journals before opening access; deleted/revoked state is not resurrected.

title: Month-end rights deadline
setup: Exercise January 31, leap February and DST boundaries.
expected: Ordinary due date is one calendar month, not a fixed 30-day addition.

title: Companion lease and outage
setup: Disconnect beyond 15-minute capture lease and then reconnect.
expected: New AisleSignals capture stops on expiry; queued old events are historical; no old command runs.

title: Staff safety and ambiguity
setup: Use own bags, returns, companion payment, crowds and accessibility aids.
expected: No appearance/identity/guilt inference; uncertain evidence can be dismissed or left unresolved.

title: Stock completeness
setup: Omit transfers, corrupt units and import the same batch twice.
expected: No definitive reconciliation on incomplete input; deterministic validated arithmetic; duplicates controlled.

title: Offboarding
setup: Terminate one tenant while another remains live.
expected: Scoped export/revocation/deletion only; other tenant unaffected; companion leases expire.

title: Device token bootstrap and renewal
setup: Enrol a valid device, exchange certificate without bearer, let bearer expire and renew; repeat with revoked/expired certificate.
expected: Valid enrolled certificate obtains scoped token; expired/revoked certificate fails; bearer expiry alone does not deadlock renewal.

title: Candidate playback without incident
setup: Create a candidate with valid evidence and null incident; review and dismiss under authorised and wrong-site users.
expected: Authorised review works without case creation; incorrect site or expired media fails.

title: Machine upload acknowledgement
setup: Complete a device upload with 202, wait through validation, then poll as owner and another device.
expected: Only owner sees committed evidence/digest; local spool is not released on 202 or validation failure.

title: Live-context challenge replay
setup: Submit wrong nonce, stale frame, nonadvancing sequence, wrong device and a duplicate valid response.
expected: Only fresh authenticated source establishes context; replay cannot refresh expiry.

title: Signed command envelope
setup: Alter pulse/device/expiry, use unknown key/algorithm and replay the verified command after restart.
expected: Signature/payload binding and persistent dispatch ledger prevent altered or repeated output.
